info.prompt: The moment of ultimate charge activation: the screen fractures into a kaleidoscope of bio-mechanical stained glass as the camera hurtles through a cyber-Gothic nave, neon cyan and magenta traceries burning like synaptic fire across vaulted gold arches, while the dice—now levitating and emitting a low monastic drone—begin to dissolve into raw data-streams, their crystalline facets exploding into a terminal-style hacker storm of gilded commit logs that swirl like incense smoke in a high-tech cathedral.
